rows.grounds: relative pronoun referring to the goddess
compound: bhairava+aṣṭaka (octad-of-bhairavas) + vanditā (saluted); describes the goddess

items.question: What identity and reverence characterize the goddess named Bhairavī Bhīṣaṇī?
premises: The goddess is identified as Bhairavī.
The goddess is characterized as terrifying.
The goddess is saluted by the octad of Bhairavas.
items.inference: The goddess Bhairavī Bhīṣaṇī is a fearsome form honored by the eight Bhairavas.
items.plain_english: She is Bhairavī, the terrifying one, who is saluted by the octad of Bhairavas.
